title: Residency ops runway and incident vignettes
summary: Working notes for operational readiness (runway) and a set of short incident vignettes to validate region-anchoring/fallback behavior. Intended for SREs, oncall, and solutions eng to run tabletop exercises and pre-flight checks before customer rollouts.
body:
Purpose:
- Create a compact, ops-friendly checklist and a handful of realistic incident vignettes to exercise region anchoring ("anchors") and fallback behavior for private deployments.
- Make sure the team has concrete evidence artifacts and comm templates for audits and customers.

Scope:
- Applies to Private (VPC/on-prem) and Dedicated customers who require region pinning or strong site affinity.
- Does NOT cover fine-grained KMS/GDPR legal analysis (see legal / product contract templates).

Operational runway (pre-rollout checklist) — quick runway items we should validate before enabling "hard anchors":
- Tenant mapping sanity: validate tenant -> region mapping table (sample 100 tenants across EU/US/APAC).
- Telemetry gating: make sure residency-evidence metrics are present for +ve and -ve cases (requests_local, requests_fallthrough, cache_hits_by_pin).
- Pin enforcement mode: smoke in soft-mode first (log-only) for 48h, then enforce with 1% canary traffic.
- Fallback-model readiness: ensure alternative model variants are registered and have verified perf profiles in target regions.
- Evidence packaging: automated bundle script (evidence-bundle.sh) produces: request IDs, routing headers, zone-annotations, and storage location.
- Legal/contract flag check: verify tenant contract flag for "region-exempt" is honored.
- Operator playbook artifact: a single, linkable ticket template that oncall can attach to customer comms.

Telemetry & acceptance signals (what we watch during runway):
- requests_local_pct >= 99.5% for pinned tenants (after 1wk stabilization)
- fallthrough_rate < 0.5% (default) — alert if > 1% for 30m
- latency_p90 by route stays within SLA (compare to baseline)
- evidence_bundle_success_rate (per tenant) > 99%
- reconciliation_delta_count (tenant mapping vs anchor index) = 0

Incident vignettes (run as tabletop; 20–30m each):
1) Zone Evacuation (simulated AZ/region outage)
- Setup: mark eu-west-1 as degraded in routing mesh; force 30% of EU traffic into fallback path.
- Expected: pinned tenants in EU should continue to be routed to EU-anchors (if available) or to the configured fallback with documented evidence.
- Operator steps: enable transparent fallback -> notify legal & account owner -> trigger evidence-bundle -> open incident ticket with template -> postmortem checklist.
- Evidence to collect: pre/post routing traces, routing decision payloads, model-variant used, customer-facing note draft.
- Key checks: no unpinned tenant receives EU data; pinned tenant fallthrough reasons recorded.

2) Misconfigured Pin (human error: tenant mapped to wrong region)
- Setup: manually flip tenant.region to us-east for one EU test-tenant in staging.
- Expected: soft-mode logs discrepancy but does not enforce; if transitioned to hard-mode, enforce rollback path must be reversible.
- Operator steps: detect via reconciliation alerts -> run reconciliation job -> validate evidence bundle -> coordinate fix with account team -> escalate to product if contract implications.
- Comms: short templated apology + description of corrective action + statement of evidence produced.

3) Evidence ingestion failure (storage or packaging outage)
- Setup: point evidence-bundle output to a broken S3-like endpoint (introduce 503s).
- Expected: system retries with exponential backoff, falls back to local queue with retention policy, raise urgent pager if buffer > threshold.
- Operator steps: check queue length, invoke disaster-recovery script to export backlog to temp blobstore, notify legal for audit implications.

Simulation exercise plan:
- Cadence: weekly tabletop for 2 months pre-rollout, then monthly for 3 months post-rollout.
- Roles: facilitator (ops lead), runner (SRE oncall), comms (customer success), legal observer.
- Success criteria: for each vignette, evidence artifacts exist, comm template drafted, and any code/config fixes landed within 5 business days.

Operator quick sequence (what to do in the first 15 minutes):
1) Acknowledge incident in PagerDuty and assign oncall.
2) Run "evidence-bundle collect <tenant>" and push to artifact store; if collector fails, flip to fallback dump.
3) Confirm routing decision via trace_id; if routing deviates, enable emergency fallback flag.
4) Post initial summary in incident channel and tag product/legal/account.

Comms snippets (short, modular) — reuse these in customer and internal updates:
- Initial: "We detected a routing anomaly affecting a subset of tenants; our team is investigating and has enabled fallbacks to preserve availability. We are collecting evidence and will follow up within 2 hours with an update."
- Customer follow-up: "We identified the root cause as a configuration mismatch and have corrected the mapping. No customer data left configured regions; attached evidence bundle #ART-12345."
- Postmortem intro: "Incident impacted pin enforcement for X tenants between T1 and T2; immediate mitigations were applied and a permanent fix was deployed."

Evidence packaging checklist (what we attach to audit):
- manifest.json with tenant-id, timestamp, anchor-region, request-ids list
- routing-traces (compressed) + routing-decision-headers
- operator-notes.txt (who touched what and when)
- reconciliation logs and pre/post mapping diff

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Decide retention policy for evidence bundles (default 90d vs customer-specified).
- [ ] Should we redact full request payloads by default (PII concerns)? Proposal: bundle keeps request IDs and headers; payloads require E-Discovery ticket.
- [ ] Add automated test in staging that flips anchors and asserts evidence bundle generation. (ENG-4578)
- [ ] Confirm legal-approved comm templates for EU / UK customers.

Quick links and references:
- Residency telemetry dashboard: /d/residency-ops-dashboard
- Reconciliation job: job-id=rcn-2024-09-a
- Evidence bundler: github.com/redwood/evidence-bundler (PR #62)
notes: Informal notes and fragmentary TODOs — expect updates after the next tabletop. Use this doc to copy comm snippets into incident ticket templates.
